newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to stronger.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to stronger.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to stronger on Monday.
Gasoline rallied on French buying some tied to the strike at three Elf refineries that entered its fifth day. Arbitrage talk also lifted prices.
Naphtha was higher in quiet trade tracking crude. Algeria's Skikda port stayed shut but NWE demand was seen lacklustre.

Gas oil slid 50 cents with IPE futures. Premiums were stable but trade was quiet as traders assessed the French strike and Nov IPE standoff. Fuel oil was steady to firmer, having spent much of the day in limbo waiting for the U.S open.
